    adj = [set() for _ in range(n)]

    return False


def sat_answer(inst):
    """Brute force: is the CNF formula satisfiable?"""
    m, clauses = inst["num_vars"], inst["clauses"]
    if any(len(c) == 0 for c in clauses):

    for bits in itertools.product([False, True], repeat=m):
